parent_objective: audit one-seed go/no-go profile smoke before any 3-seed pilot
blocked_by: M1495 is a one-seed plumbing smoke and cannot support profile ranking or self-ID claims
supersedes: direct 3-seed pilot without auditing the L2 current-tiled and L3 reset trends

public_gates: M1496 must audit M1495 before any 3-seed pilot
M1496 must separate plumbing completion from one-seed trend interpretation
M1496 must report L2 normal/current-tiled and L3 online/reset trends
M1496 must block profile ranking, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, and self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim architecture ranking or recurrent self-identification from one seed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits one-seed matrix completion and decides whether 3-seed pilot is justified
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats one-seed trends as profile ranking
stop if audit ignores current-tiled parity
stop if audit ignores L3 online versus reset-control trend
stop if audit admits promotion or private holdout
fallback_plan: route to 3-seed public pilot only if plumbing is clean and audit accepts public-trend value
route to L3 recipe repair or decisive-task route if standard profile scaling is not high leverage

admission_evidence: M1495 completed 12 of 12 profile runs with finite metrics
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up 3-seed public pilot or repair/design manifest
next_stage_criteria: one-seed trends are classified as non-conclusive

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1496 audits whether current-tiled controls match L2, but cannot make self-ID claims from one seed.
history_necessity_tests: audit L2 normal versus current-tiled one-seed trend
audit L3 online versus corrected reset-control one-seed trend
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: one fixed-budget public seed per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record negative trends without overclaiming; decide whether more profile scaling or a different decisive task is justified.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1495 should be treated as a clean plumbing pass with non-conclusive but important L2 current-tiled and L3 reset-control trends.
success_criteria: audit records completion and finite metrics
audit records L2 normal/current-tiled one-seed trend
audit records L3 online/reset one-seed trend
audit blocks promotion private holdout profile ranking corpus export and self-ID claims
audit routes to 3-seed pilot or a clearly justified alternative
failure_criteria: audit treats one-seed trends as ranking
audit starts training replay PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1496 passes if it audits M1495 and routes the matrix branch without overclaiming one-seed trends.
